bayeuxTickets.headline: Every ticket for 10 September to 31 December 2026 is sold out. General booking for 1 January to 31 March 2027 opens on 21 October 2026. April to July 2027 opens 'early 2027'.
bayeuxTickets.verifiedNote: britishmuseum.org blocks curl. The page was read in a browser on 7 October 2026 by the coordinating session, which supplied the facts below. A copy archived on 3 October agrees on the dates, the sold-out window and the prices.
bayeuxTickets.runs: 10 September 2026 to 11 July 2027, Room 30 (the Sainsbury Exhibitions Gallery)
bayeuxTickets.hours: Sunday to Wednesday 10.00 to 18.00; Thursday to Saturday 10.00 to 21.00
bayeuxTickets.members: Members' priority booking for October to December and for January to March is fully booked. The final members' window, for April to July 2027, opens in January 2027.

prices.standard: Adults £33 (£36.50 with the £3.50 donation); students, 16 to 18s and jobseekers £25; under-16s free with an adult, at most four per adult

bayeuxTickets.terms: Maximum 10 tickets per booking. Tickets can only be used by the booker and ID may be checked. A free audio guide is in the British Museum Audio app; bring headphones.

exhibitionsOpening.title: London Museum at Smithfield (permanent galleries)
exhibitionsOpening.detail: Three spaces: Real Time, Our Time, Past Time. Includes the Cheapside Hoard, a six-metre window onto the Thameslink line, the Lord Mayor's Coach and Syd's Coffee Stall. The spotlight exhibition London Tastes, with Ruby Tandoh and Jonathan Nunn, runs November 2026 to August 2027. The 1960s Poultry Market, for temporary exhibitions, opens in 2028.
